memory: Gap is real and reproducible. With aluminum high‑Ra Δμ = 0.121±0.035; swapping the high‑Ra cap to stainless steel (same Ra) reduced Δμ to 0.095±0.033 (~22% reduction) but left it significant. Edge‑origin and N‑dependence persist. Top/bottom swap earlier reduced Δμ ~18%; light cleaning previously increased Δμ. Standing hypothesis: substrate properties (elastic modulus, oxide/chemistry) modulate but do not create the contrast; topography remains primary driver.
openQuestion: If I coat the steel high‑Ra cap with a thin aluminum film (keeping Ra), does Δμ return to the aluminum magnitude?
